title: You Can Buy Extra Time
youtube_title: In This Roblox Town, You Can Buy Extra Time...
tiktok_caption: $1 = 1 extra minute. Never buy more than 60. ⏰
thumbnail_rec: Max in a blue jacket face to face with an old version of himself holding a giant glowing clock, the frozen town under a pure white sky.

lines.text: In this town, you can buy extra time.
There's a mysterious clock shop where one dollar buys one extra minute.
People use it to finish homework, sleep longer, or escape being late.
But there's one rule.
Never buy more than sixty minutes.
One day, a boy named Max walked into the shop.
He placed a hundred dollars on the counter.
The shopkeeper looked terrified.
But Max insisted.
Suddenly, every clock in town stopped.
Cars froze.
Birds hung motionless in the air.
And the sky turned completely white.
Max smiled.
He had finally stopped time.
But then he noticed someone walking toward him.
An old man carrying an enormous clock.
The man looked exactly like Max.
He pointed at the clock and whispered,
“You didn't buy extra time.”
“You borrowed it from me.”
Then the clock began counting backward.
And Max started getting older.
